rationale: I read the complete held EO 11492 (34 FR 17721, Oct. 30, 1969): one operative sentence amending EO 11398 of March 4, 1968 by substituting a new subsection (a) of section 3 that establishes the Citizens Advisory Committee on Physical Fitness and Sports (composition, Chairman, meets on call of the Chairman). It has no own term and no savings clause; its force exists only as text of EO 11398. I read the held full text of EO 11562 (35 FR 15063, Sept. 25, 1970): sec. 2 establishes the President's Council on Physical Fitness and Sports, sec. 6(a) deems it a continuation of the Citizens Advisory Committee 'which has heretofore existed under Executive Order No. 11398 ... as amended', and sec. 7 (Revocations) provides 'Executive Order No. 11398 of March 4, 1968, and Executive Order No. 11492 of October 30, 1969, are hereby revoked.' EO 11492 is revoked by number and date, as a whole. Sec. 8 (Construction) only says the order does not abrogate functions vested by law in any agency; it saves nothing of EO 11492. D6 self-check: the only later event is EO 11562 (catalog 'Revoked by: EO 11562'). No other held instrument names EO 11492. EO 11562 was itself amended by EO 11945 and EO 12098 and revoked by EO 12345 (sec. 'Executive Order No. 11562, as amended, is revoked', which I read); EO 12345 does not mention EO 11398 or EO 11492, so nothing revives the revoked order. Catalog note and 1989 snapshot are leads only and agree. Provisional NO hypothesis.
